description_en: Upgrades the database version of a MongoDB instance
description_zh: 升级MongoDB实例的数据库版本
name: UpgradeDBInstanceEngineVersion

parameters.help_en:
The target database version for the upgrade.

The storage engine of the instance imposes constraints on the selection of database versions. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/398673.html. You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468471.html operation to query the versions to which the instance can be upgraded
parameters.help_zh:
升级的目标数据库版本。

实例的存储引擎对数据库版本的选择有约束性，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/398673.html，您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468471.html接口查询实例可升级的版本
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en:
The upgrade mode for the instance version. Valid values:

0: Immediate upgrade.
1: Upgrade within the maintenance window
parameters.help_zh:
实例版本升级模式。取值：

0：立即升级。
1：在可运维时间段内升级
parameters.name: switch_mode

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can generate the value of this parameter on the client side. Make sure that the value is unique across different requests and contains a maximum of 64 ASCII characters. The value cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符，且该参数值中不能包含非 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: Performs a dry run without actually calling the operation. The system checks items such as request parameters, request format, business limits, and inventory. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request and directly executes the operation after the check succeeds
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次请求执行预检查，取值：
true：执行预检查，不真正调用该接口。检查项包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误；如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接执行本次操作
parameters.name: dry_run
